0.title: Cold Clear's three quads and a T-spin double
0.summary: From the same board, Cold Clear drops its first I upright into column 9 and clears a quad. yachi puts that I upright in column 8, clears nothing, and keeps stacking. Cold Clear goes on to two more quads (b2b rising) and a T-spin double, 20 attack in total, against yachi's quad, triple and two combo singles for 7. After 14 pieces yachi's stack is 7 rows higher.

claims.text: human step 1: the I is placed standing in column 8 and clears no lines
cc step 1: the I drops into column 9 and clears a quad for 4 attack
human step 8: the I in column 9 clears a quad for 4 attack
cc step 10: a second back-to-back quad, this time in column 6, sends 5
cc step 13: a T-spin double at b2b 3 sends 6
by step 14 the totals are 7 attack for yachi and 20 for Cold Clear, and yachi's stack top is 7 rows higher (row 13 vs row 6)

1.title: Cold Clear's two quads against yachi's taller stack
1.summary: yachi stacks four pieces, scores a T-spin single at step 5 and a single at step 7, then places five pieces without clearing. After step 11, 4 garbage rows enter from the bottom and push a stack already 15 rows high up to row 19. Cold Clear clears two doubles, then a quad with an I from hold in column 3. The same 4 rows enter under its much lower stack, and its next I, in column 6, clears a back-to-back quad. yachi clears a triple and a double at the end, and the clip finishes 11 attack to 5, with yachi's stack 6 rows higher.

claims.text: human step 5: a T-spin single clears 1 line for 2 attack
cc step 7: the I from hold drops into column 3 and clears a quad for 4 attack
human step 11: the Z clears nothing and 4 garbage rows are inserted at the bottom right after it
cc step 11: the Z clears 0 lines and the 4 pending garbage rows are inserted
cc step 12: the I in column 6 clears a back-to-back quad for 5 attack
by step 14 the totals are 5 attack for yachi and 11 for Cold Clear, and yachi's stack top is 6 rows higher (row 15 vs row 9)

2.title: A nine-piece combo against broken-up clears
2.summary: Both sides start from the same board: a short, uneven stack on 10 garbage rows whose holes are in different columns. Both mostly clear one line at a time. Cold Clear clears on nine pieces in a row (steps 2 to 10) and reaches combo 8, so its late singles send 2 each and the final double sends 3. yachi's clears are interrupted by pieces that clear nothing, and yachi sends only 2 in total, against Cold Clear's 12.

claims.text: human step 1: the L clears 1 line and back-to-back is lost (b2b goes from 0 to -1)
human step 9: the I is placed standing in column 1 without clearing, and 3 garbage rows are inserted after it
cc step 8: a flat I clears 1 line at combo 6 for 2 attack
cc step 10: the L clears 2 lines at combo 8 for 3 attack, the ninth clearing piece in a row
cc step 11: the Z clears nothing, ending the combo, and 3 garbage rows are inserted
by step 14 the totals are 2 attack for yachi and 12 for Cold Clear, and yachi's stack top is 4 rows higher (row 14 vs row 10)

3.title: Same T, two rows higher
3.summary: Both sides start with the same T. Cold Clear drops it into the slot at the bottom-left for a T-spin double, while yachi places it two rows higher and clears nothing. Cold Clear adds an I quad and a back-to-back T-spin double, ending 14 to 4 in attack. yachi clears nothing over the last six pieces, and the stack finishes 7 rows taller.

claims.text: The T goes flat across columns 1-3 on row 9 with its nub in column 2 below it. It clears no lines.
The same T goes into the slot at row 7 with its nub in column 2 on row 6. It is a T-spin double for 4 attack.
An I standing in column 3 clears a quad for 4 attack.
A T clears 2 lines as a T-spin double. With back-to-back it sends 5.
An I standing in column 4 clears 2 lines for 1 attack, right after 4 garbage rows arrived.
Totals are 4 attack for yachi and 14 for Cold Clear. yachi's stack reaches row 17 and Cold Clear's reaches row 10.

4.title: Same quad, then a Cold Clear T-spin
4.summary: Both sides clear the same I quad down column 5 for 4 attack. Cold Clear then places four pieces without clearing, and a T from hold clears 2 lines as a T-spin double, sending 5 with back-to-back. yachi's next two clears are singles worth 0 each, and the first of them breaks back-to-back. yachi finishes the 14 pieces with 5 attack in total.

claims.text: An I standing in column 5 clears a quad for 4 attack.
An I standing in column 5 clears a quad for 4 attack, in the same well yachi uses.
A T clears a single with no spin. It sends 0 and breaks back-to-back.
A T taken from hold clears 2 lines as a T-spin double. With back-to-back it sends 5.
An I standing in column 10 clears 2 lines for 1 attack, after 5 garbage rows came in on the previous piece.
yachi's total over the 14 pieces is 5 attack.

5.title: Cold Clear chains clears, 17-4
5.summary: Cold Clear (seed 1) cleared lines on 5 of its first 6 pieces, and on four in a row from step 3. That run ended with a T-spin double for 6 and a quad for 8, so Cold Clear had sent 15 of its 17 attack by step 6, and its board was down to 2 garbage rows plus two J cells. yachi's only attack is a single quad at step 6 worth 4, after 7 garbage rows had arrived (5 after step 4, 2 after step 5). After the 14 pieces yachi's stack reaches row 16 and Cold Clear's reaches row 10.

claims.text: Step 5: the T (from hold) clears 2 lines as a T-spin for 6 attack, filling row 8 at columns 7-9 and row 7 at column 8.
Step 6: an I placed vertically in column 5 clears 4 lines for 8 attack (b2b 1, combo 3), so Cold Clear has 15 of its 17 total attack after 6 pieces.
Step 6: an I placed vertically in column 6 clears 4 lines for 4 attack, which is all of yachi's attack across the 14 pieces.
5 garbage rows are inserted after step 4 and 2 more after step 5, so 7 rows arrive before the step-6 quad.
Step 7: the S clears nothing and 7 garbage rows are inserted after it. Before that step the board held only 2 garbage rows.
After step 14 yachi's highest filled cell is in row 16 and Cold Clear's is in row 10. Lines cleared over the 14 pieces: 8 for yachi, 14 for Cold Clear.

6.title: Same T-spin, different payoff
6.summary: Both sides drop the T in the same cells at step 2. Cold Clear's step-1 S had already filled columns 7-8 of the upper row of the T slot, where yachi's S left a gap, so Cold Clear's T-spin completes two rows for 6 and yachi's completes one for 4. Yachi's next piece, a Z, clears 2 lines without a spin and breaks back-to-back. Cold Clear keeps back-to-back through quads with the I at steps 7 and 10 and only breaks it with a plain single at step 11. It leads 18 attack to 7 and finishes with a lower stack (10 rows against 13).

claims.text: step 2: both sides put the T in the same cells (columns 4-6). yachi's T-spin clears 1 line for 4 attack and Cold Clear's clears 2 lines for 6
human step 3: the Z clears 2 lines with no spin, which breaks back-to-back (b2b goes from 4 to -1)
cc step 7: the I, taken from hold, stands in column 5 and clears a quad for 6 attack. Back-to-back goes up to 5
cc step 10: an I standing in column 4 clears a second quad for 6 attack, with back-to-back at 6
step 6: both sides take 5 garbage rows after their L, which clears nothing
after 14 pieces Cold Clear has 18 attack to yachi's 7, and yachi's stack is 3 rows higher (13 against 10)

7.title: One extra quad at the end
7.summary: Both sides clear a quad with their first I (Cold Clear at step 5, yachi at step 7) and both score a T-spin double. Cold Clear also clears a second I quad in column 5 at step 14 for 5 more (yachi's second I went into column 10 at step 12 and cleared nothing), and it finishes 14 to 10 with one row left above the garbage.

claims.text: cc step 5: an I standing in column 5 clears a quad for 4 attack
human step 7: the I, taken from hold, stands in column 5 and clears a quad for 4 attack
human step 12: the I, taken from hold, stands in column 10 and clears no lines

cc step 14: an I in column 5 clears a second quad for 5 attack, with back-to-back at 2
after 14 pieces Cold Clear has 14 attack to yachi's 10, and yachi's stack is 6 rows higher (10 against 4)

8.title: T-spin double before the quad
8.summary: Both sides place the same pieces in the same cells for the step-5 quad (5 attack) and the step-6 O, which clears one line and breaks back-to-back. At step 13 both clear the same quad with an I in column 8. Cold Clear set it up with a T-spin double at step 12, so its quad counts back-to-back and combo and is worth 6, while yachi's is worth 4. Cold Clear wins 15 to 9.

step 6: both sides put the O in columns 9-10 and clear 1 line, which breaks back-to-back (b2b -1)
cc step 12: the T, taken from hold, makes a T-spin double in columns 7-9 for 4 attack
step 13: both sides stand an I in column 8 in the same cells and clear a quad. yachi's is worth 4 and Cold Clear's is worth 6, at back-to-back 1 and combo 1
after 14 pieces Cold Clear has 15 attack to yachi's 9, and yachi's stack is 3 rows higher (11 against 8)

9.title: Single breaks the back-to-back chain
9.summary: Both sides open with the same T-spin double and the same quad in column 5. yachi then clears the next line with a plain Z single, which resets back-to-back, and its next T clears nothing, which ends the combo; its second quad, in column 10, sends 4. Cold Clear clears that same line with a T-spin mini instead, keeping back-to-back and the combo alive, and its column-10 quad sends 9. Final attack is 20 for Cold Clear and 13 for yachi.

claims.text: human step 3 and cc step 2: a T-spin double sends 4 lines on both sides
human step 7: the Z clears 1 line with no spin, and back-to-back resets to -1
cc step 8: the T clears 1 line as a T-spin mini, sending 2 and keeping back-to-back alive (b2b 2)
human step 9: the I goes standing into column 10 and clears a quad, sending 4

10.title: T-spin double plus a double edge out a lone quad
10.summary: Both sides take 5 rows of garbage with the hole in column 5 after step 5. yachi builds and clears a T-spin double for 4, then an O double for 1. Cold Clear clears one quad in column 10 for 4 and sends nothing else. yachi ends 5 to 4 ahead with a stack one row lower.

11.title: Cold Clear keeps the combo going
11.summary: Both sides clear singles with their first two pieces. yachi's third piece clears nothing, which ends its combo at 2. Cold Clear clears a third single and then a quad in column 2 at combo 4 for 8. Cold Clear adds a T-spin double for 5 and a second quad for 5, and ends with every garbage row cleared and 20 attack. yachi, with a T-spin double for 4 and a quad for 5, ends at 10 with 5 garbage rows left.
